sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Nothotsuga longibracteata is an evergreen conifer from southern China and the only species in its genus. It reaches about 30 m and grows on humid mountain slopes and ridges at 300–2,300 m.

sections.title: Needles and cones
sections.text: The radial needles are about 1.1–2.4 cm long and 1–2.5 mm wide. The erect cones are 2–5.8 cm long; their long, protruding bracts are distinctive and turn brown at maturity.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: The wood is used for construction and furniture. No food use is known in the sources consulted.
